top_categories.workout_context: 78 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
50ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Gran Fondo Curacavi's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 78 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Curacavi's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
Base fitness for Gran Fondo Curacavi. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Curacavi. Train it until it feels boring.
At Gran Fondo Curacavi, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mixed terrain at tempo for 78 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Gran Fondo Curacavi, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on mixed terrain. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.heat: April in Curacaví, Santiago Metropolitan Region, Chile (course crosses into Casablanca, Valparaíso Region) can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Gran Fondo Curacavi. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Gran Fondo Curacavi’s 78 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Gran Fondo Curacavi. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Gran Fondo Curacavi requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and VO2max to prepare you for 78 miles of mixed terrain in Curacaví, Santiago Metropolitan Region, Chile (course crosses into Casablanca, Valparaíso Region).
